news.title: Spain Dismisses Ceuta Crisis Impact on 2030 World Cup Final Debate
news.lede: Rabat – Spain’s Minister for Education, Vocational Training and Sport, Milagros Tolón, has rejected suggestions that the migration crisis in Ceuta could affect the decision over the venue of the 2030 FIFA World Cup final. Speaking to Spanish public broadcaster TVE, Tolón said she does not believe the situation in Ceuta will influence FIFA’s decision on where to stage the tournament’s showpiece match. “Who decides is FIFA,” Tolón said, stressing that the Spanish Ministry of Sport is working with all parties involved in the 2030 World Cup to deliver what she described as the best edition of the tournament. She also pointed to Spain’s football success and sporting infrastructure as reasons for her confidence in the country’s chances.

news.title: Ballon d'Or 2026 nominees: Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham and Declan Rice nominated
news.lede: Harry Kane scored 73 goals last season for club and country. Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane is one of three England players nominated for the 2026 Ballon d'Or. Real Madrid's Jude Bellingham and Arsenal's Declan Rice join Kane, the favourite for the award, on the 30-player shortlist. Inter Miami forward Lionel Messi, who is looking to win his ninth Ballon d'Or, has been nominated.

REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann/File Photo European Leagues has expanded its complaint to the European Commission, accusing FIFA of prioritising its own competitions and commercial interests at the expense of women’s football, player welfare and domestic leagues. NYON A group representing many of Europe’s major football leagues has accused FIFA of “abusive conduct” in how it runs the international calendar for women’s competitions after filing an expanded complaint to the European Commission.

news.title: Barca star Yamal says will not beg for Ballon d'Or
news.lede: Barcelona star Lamine Yamal said Tuesday he will not beg for the Ballon d'Or trophy after winning the World Cup with Spain and La Liga with the Catalan giants. On Monday Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappe made his case to win the trophy, highlighting his World Cup Golden Boot win, which also saw him become the competition's all-time top goalscorer. Yamal, 19, thought he had played very well while winning trophies for club and country but said he was happy to let others decide whether he deserved the prize. The teenager, Mbappe, Harry Kane, Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia are the main candidates to win the award at the ceremony in London on 26 October.

news.title: Indian women could reach FIFA World Cup before the men: Dalima Chhibber
news.lede: India international Dalima Chhibber believes India’s women have the potential to reach the FIFA Women’s World Cup before the men’s team, but says that potential needs a proper pathway to become reality.Speaking to The Bridge on the sidelines of the inaugural SuperNova Football Championship in Bengaluru, Chhibber pointed to the growing interest in girls’ football while stressing that participation alone will not be enough.For her, the next step is creating a consistent system that develops players from a young age and gives them the experience required to compete internationally.“. There is so much potential,” Chhibber said. “I know everybody keeps talking about that, yes, girls are going to reach the World Cup before the men do. And I certainly believe that as well.”

news.title: More than 100,000 back complaint over Infantino's Trump ties, says FairSquare
news.lede: Sept 8 - More than 100,000 people have signed a complaint demanding that FIFA investigate President Gianni Infantino for alleged breaches of the world soccer governing body's code of ethics related to his connections with U.S. President Donald Trump, human rights organisation FairSquare said on Tuesday. The complaint was filed by FairSquare and its "Reboot FIFA" campaign, which accuses Infantino of multiple breaches outlined in a letter to FIFA's Ethics Committee seen by Reuters. The allegations include abuse of power, breaching political neutrality duties and violating loyalty obligations in efforts to "ingratiate himself with the U.S.

news.title: Norway’s viral World Cup Viking Row has officially made its way into American college football
news.lede: Norway's Viking Row was one of the most viral fan traditions of the 2026 World Cup. Now, two months later, it has officially made its way into American college football. The University of Minnesota debuted its own version of the synchronized rowing chant at its season opener at Huntington Bank Stadium, with the student section sitting in rows and mimicking the same exaggerated rowing motion that Norwegian fans made famous this summer. Former Gophers linebacker Kamal Martin led the chant before kickoff.

news.title: Spanish officials politicize World Cup over Ceuta crisis
news.lede: Spanish political and football circles have once again demonstrated their willingness to weaponize sport for short-term political gain, this time by dragging the July migrant crisis in Ceuta into the debate over the 2030 FIFA World Cup final. Last Friday, Rafael Louzán, president of the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF), travelled to Ceuta accompanied by national team coach Luis de la Fuente. What was presented as a gesture of solidarity quickly turned into a thinly veiled political operation. Louzán used the enclave to push Spain’s claim for the World Cup final while explicitly linking the migrant arrivals of late July to the joint Spain-Portugal-Morocco candidacy.
